caption: The drawing depicts a single, round-bodied stoneware jar with a narrow opening at the top and a short neck that flares slightly outward. The jar is mostly a muted, earthy brown color with darker shading to suggest depth and form. There are several irregular patches of lighter tan or off-white color scattered across the surface, indicating areas of wear or texture. The rim of the jar is highlighted with a blue tint, and there is a blue rectangular label or stamp near the upper portion that contains textual information reading “C. CROLIUS / MANUFACTURER / NEW YORK.” The background is plain and light, providing contrast to the jar. The artist’s signature is faintly visible in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
